mechanics.player_action: Move one lane left or right.
mechanics.system_rule: The player occupies one of three discrete lanes and commits to a 12-frame interpolated change.
mechanics.goal_link: Avoid lane-bound threats and align with celestial energy.

input_binding.binding_description: Pressed edge requests one adjacent lane change.

activation_context.state_requirements: Active chase phase, not paused, not already changing lanes.

rules_and_limits: No wrap from left to right lane.
A new lane request is rejected until the current 12-frame change finishes.
versatility_cases: align with a celestial energy pickup
set up a safe jump lane

combination_map.combo_effect: Change lane before or after a jump to solve paired threats.
Reposition while Pulse clears the immediate lane pressure.

failure_states.failure_condition: Player requests movement beyond the outer lane.
failure_states.consequence: Request is rejected with no displacement.

failure_states.failure_condition: Lane change finishes inside an active threat.
failure_states.consequence: Player takes one integrity damage and pressure increases.
failure_states.recovery_path: Invulnerability window allows a corrective move.

feedback_model.visual: Hero interpolates between lane anchors and emits a short dust accent.
feedback_model.audio: Short lane shift cue at movement start.
feedback_model.haptic_or_camera: No shake; camera remains stable to preserve readability.

scaffolding_steps: Spawn first energy in the current lane.
Spawn second energy in an adjacent lane with no threat.
Introduce a single marked lane after the first successful change.

test_scenarios.setup: Player idle in center lane and LEFT is pressed.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Player reaches left anchor in 12 frames and cannot leave the road.

test_scenarios.setup: RIGHT is pressed twice during one change.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Only one adjacent lane change occurs.

test_scenarios.setup: Active threat occupies center and LEFT is pressed before the active window.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Threat misses and pressure does not increase.

reward.drop_or_progression_ref: lane alignment grants energy and pressure relief

mechanics.system_rule: A starts a fixed deterministic jump arc when grounded; landing restores grounded state.
mechanics.goal_link: Avoid low barriers while preserving the chosen lane.

input_binding.binding_description: Pressed edge starts a jump only while grounded.

activation_context.state_requirements: Active chase phase, grounded, not paused.

rules_and_limits: Lane changes remain available during the jump.
High marked attacks are not avoided by jumping.
versatility_cases: combine with a lane change over paired threats

combination_map.combo_effect: Airborne lane adjustment solves staggered barrier patterns.
Pulse during jump clears the landing zone.

failure_states.failure_condition: The jump begins after the collision window.
failure_states.recovery_path: Use the invulnerability window and re-align.

feedback_model.visual: Hero rises on a fixed arc with takeoff and landing dust.
feedback_model.audio: Jump cue at takeoff and landing cue on contact.

scaffolding_steps: Place one isolated low barrier after lane movement is taught.
Later pair a low barrier with a lane reward.

test_scenarios.setup: Press A 18 frames before a low barrier reaches the player.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Barrier misses and no damage is applied.

test_scenarios.setup: Press A twice during the same arc.
Complete a jump with no obstacle.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Grounded state returns and landing cue plays once.

mechanics.system_rule: B activates only at 100 energy, clears active threats, reduces pressure and grants a short safety window.
mechanics.goal_link: Convert successful collection and survival into recovery during high pressure.

input_binding.binding_description: Pressed edge activates Pulse when the meter is full.

activation_context.state_requirements: Active chase phase, pulse energy equals 100, not paused.

rules_and_limits: Clears active threats but does not skip the phase timer.
Reduces pressure by 28 and grants 45 frames of safety.

combination_map.combo_effect: Pulse creates a safe repositioning window.
Pulse can clear an unsafe landing zone.

failure_states.failure_condition: B is pressed below full energy.
failure_states.consequence: Pulse does not activate and a short unavailable cue plays.

failure_states.failure_condition: Player hoards Pulse until pressure reaches 100.

feedback_model.visual: Palette flash, expanding light band and active threat clear.
feedback_model.haptic_or_camera: Four-frame hitstop followed by a controlled outward shake.

scaffolding_steps: Provide enough safe pickups to fill the first meter.
Flash the full meter and play the ready cue.
Follow with a readable paired threat that rewards activation.

test_scenarios.expected_outcome: No Pulse activates and energy remains 80.

test_scenarios.setup: Press B at 100 energy with two active threats.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Threats clear, pressure drops by 28 and energy becomes 0.

test_scenarios.setup: Activate Pulse immediately before an active collision.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: No damage occurs during the 45-frame safety window.

reward.drop_or_progression_ref: energy collection becomes a pressure recovery tool

mechanics.player_action: Manage mistakes, collections and Pulse timing to keep pressure below 100.
mechanics.system_rule: Pressure is a deterministic 0-100 value that rises on mistakes and falls on clean play or Pulse.
mechanics.goal_link: Survive until the portal without being caught.

input_binding.binding_description: All core mechanics affect pressure through their outcomes.

rules_and_limits: Phase transitions increase passive pressure cadence.

feedback_model.visual: Pressure meter, pursuer proximity and warmer palette.
feedback_model.audio: Danger cue cadence accelerates at high pressure.

scaffolding_steps: Increase pressure after the first visible mistake.

test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Pressure becomes 48 and integrity decreases by one.
Pressure clamps to 100 and failure result begins.
